description: Deploys a set of metadata components directly to the org using the Metadata API SOAP deploy operation. Builds a package.xml and deployment zip in memory. Supports validate-only (checkOnly:true) for pre-deployment validation without making changes. Specify runTests to execute test classes during deployment (required for production). Polls until complete or timeout.

checkOnly.description: Validate only, do not actually deploy

components.description: Metadata components to include in the deployment package. These reference components already in the org. Can be empty when using componentsXml to deploy new/updated components with inline XML.

componentsXml.description: Optional inline XML components to deploy. Each entry provides the complete XML definition (type, name, xml). The file path is inferred from type/name. When provided alongside components, both are deployed together.

xml.description: Complete XML content for this component (the full metadata file content, not just a fragment)

rollbackOnError.description: Roll back all changes if any component fails

runTests.description: Test classes to run during deployment

testLevel.description: Test level: NoTestRun, RunSpecifiedTests, RunLocalTests, or RunAllTestsInOrg

waitMinutes.description: Max minutes to wait for deploy to complete

name: sf_deploy_metadata
title: Deploy Metadata
